issue_context.title: [Svelte 5] bind:this not correctly updating state inline with Svelte 4
issue_context.body:
### Describe the bug

This one I'm not able to fully articulate. If we have `bind:this` in separate `#if` statements, it's not able to correctly update `bind:this`, while `#if` and `:else if` does work.

In the REPL if you move forward through the tabs it correctly console logs the DOM elements, but moving backwards through it is console logging `null`.
